listing.name: The Last Guardian (The Last Guardian — native PC port)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared The Last Guardian Windows installation through its waiting saved-settings play route. Upstream owns game preparation and runtime replacement; keep the actual configurable save root and separate launcher preferences.

steps.title: Prepare this exact PS4 game upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete copy and components you are independently permitted to use. The reviewed v2026.10.27-4825a99 route needs your own decrypted The Last Guardian PS4 folder for CUSA03627 USA or CUSA03745 Europe with update 01.03, with the update’s eboot.bin, sce_module/libc.prx and libSceFios2.prx, sce_sys and all matching game data. Follow the selected upstream setup outside Portcove, choose the intended copy and save settings; no other region/revision or exact full-input digest is qualified here. The documented native-audio route additionally needs decrypted libSceNgs2.sprx from your own console. No console module is supplied or licensed by the runtime grant; the alternative HLE audio path is a separate upstream setting, not a silently substituted qualification. No original, firmware, helper, script or game is obtained or executed by this registration.

steps.title: Keep the complete matching Windows package
steps.instruction: The inspected selected Windows ZIP contains tlg-windows-x86_64/The Last Guardian.exe, a separate classic frontend, Play shortcut, out/tlg-probe.exe and the matching frozen-runtime, scripts, DLLs and resources. Keep the complete extracted package in a writable location. Select the current ordinary frontend, not its classic sibling, Play wrapper, internal probe/GPU helper, Python, a DLL or the original PS4 eboot.bin. Static AMD64 headers do not establish GPU/driver or dynamic dependency acceptance.

steps.title: Select the waiting direct-play intent
steps.instruction: After upstream first setup and preparation are complete, select The Last Guardian.exe, use its full extracted tlg-windows-x86_64 directory as working directory, and use the single argument --play. Review the exact selected intent, then request Play separately. The pinned frontend dispatches --play to its runner with no finite gameplay timeout; that runner waits/polls for the game child’s exit. The ordinary GUI has separate close-on-play/reopen behavior, so do not substitute that mode as the same process-lifetime evidence. Finish any new preparation outside attachment; no child cleanup or gameplay has been observed here.

steps.title: Preserve the actual save root and both preference files
steps.instruction: Keep the whole active user-data tree, including savedata/<user>/<serial>.memory/memory.dat (SaveDataMemory), existing slot folders and savedata_backups, tlg.ini, backups, caches, mods/DLC configuration and logs, plus the original game/module directories. Its source priority is an established TLG_USER_DIR, then user_dir in %APPDATA%/TLG-PC/launcher.json, then user beside the package. Also retain %APPDATA%/tlg-launcher/settings.json: it is a different launcher-preference file, not the data-root pointer. GPU/cache/mod overrides or separately configured backup destinations can add roots; preserve all effective locations. Do not set a new override, move a folder or infer compatibility with another Hayato title here.

steps.title: Complete upstream maintenance and detached paths separately
steps.instruction: Upstream owns save-management/backup behavior, shader preparation, updates and recovery. These are not Portcove backup/import/rollback guarantees. Complete setup, updater applier/recovery, close-on-play/reopen and runtime replacement outside an attached session; close all actual players, helpers and successors before changing files, keep independent copies, then review/relink changed bytes. The runner’s normal wait does not make forced parent termination a child-quiescence or save-flush guarantee; the GUI and some runner paths create independent children. Quit the actual game normally.

steps.title: Retain title-specific acceptance and rights limits
steps.instruction: Preserve the project GPL 2-or-later and all component/NVIDIA/font notices; these do not grant original-game or console-firmware rights. Windows is an automatically built package with gameplay explicitly untested in the selected README. Linux30FPS/session claims do not transfer to Windows;60FPS/unlocked modes remain experimental. Upstream audio, save, graphics and controller statements remain attributable upstream claims. No Portcove gameplay, save/reload, native-installed or Supported acceptance is asserted. Removing registration preserves all external files; managed install/update/rollback/backup/deletion are unavailable.

warnings: Preserve the actual TLG-PC data-root pointer, separate launcher settings and every effective save/backup location; complete upstream preparation and restart/update paths outside attachment.
